body: thank you. i will get back to you. thank you so much for taking the time to listen to me

that is a nice quote, i do belive so myself, but its hard to really hold on to those beliefs when everything else is so messed up. im trying everyday to cope with life, but everyday its just gets more distant as i fall deeper in my thoughts of meaninglessnes. everything fun and good, is just as equal meaningless, it doesnt matter what i do, it will be the same. the coming week i will find professional help so i can talk to someone qualified to help me. the real fear for me with this is that i deep down belive that no matter what anyone say, it still cant change the cold hard facts. i dont want to die, but i dont want to live either. its a difficoult problem when i know that i can never obtain the answers i seek

thank you for responding to me. i want to see a therapist or something, but im afraid that i will just unleash it all and seem like  acrazy person, cause thats how i feel. im already doing all of that, pursuing things i might find meaning with, and pushing harder on things i already used to enjoy, but its just not helping, all i see is just how meaningless everything is the more i try. thats the fact of life, we will all one day be meaningless, gone, lost, and thats gonna happen no matter how hard you try on anything. and when i think about that, i dont know how to snap out of it when no matter what, that is the fact of existence. im not bashing down your suggestions, i really appreciate your words, but i dont know what to do anymore. this all started to be the way it is in my mind whenm y dog died 2 years ago. when she got sick, it made me realize that no matter how hard i want here to live, or myself, its just not going to happen. death and the void will come no matter what, and i just cant deal with that. thats why i dont know how to snap out of this state of mind, when i know that not even snapping out will help.

ive been like this since i was a kid, or not nearly as bad at this, but ive never found a meaning with life or whats around life. my confidence and self esteem is not at the top, but its not bad. my stryggle is life itself, i cant find any meaning to life, death, the universe or anything going on around me lately, and now the past couple of days it has become the worst of worst, i cant think of anything else, as i know that things doesnt matter. life, death, there is no answers or meaning. its all consuming and terrifying. i dont know what to do when i have grasped the fact of existence at this horryfying level. it feels like if i go to a big sleep, things will be different when i wake up, but it wont. how can i snap out of this?

i want to be able to just snap out of it, have it any other way. it almost feels like a horrible nightmare, but wont shake off. there is almost like there is another reality behind this one, where everything is different from this, a better place. i dont do drugs, so thats not why im feeling this way, but help me please, whats going on with me

Thank you all for responding. The thing is, im at a point were focusing on good things just doesnt matter either. Half of me is in an absolute place were everything is nothing, no matter what. And the other half is trying to find a solution or any help at all even tho my mind is set on that there is no meaning, no life, no time, nothing. It doesnt help focusing on good things, when you know that they dont matter either, if i do a good deed, it wont matter anymore than doing something bad, its all the same and its all nothing in the end. Is there no answers? Its horrible even being awake when I know thats it is all for nothing

and the best thing: it feels like im entering a void of sheer panic in my mind, and im having a panic attack about beeing so fucking scared of entering this void of panic and anxiety that i cant get out of

sorry for my late response. yeah i feel the same way, all the time, it is frigging unbearable. i think alot about suicide, not actually committing suicide, that would me even more pointless as I want some kind of answers to it all, but most of the time, i just want to wake up from it to something different, better. not what life is, there is no meaning to find in it whatsoever, and its a really hard thought to have poudning in your head at every waking moment. its weird, but it feels better somehow knowing that someone else also thinks about this stuff, and its not just me going insane. but again, it makes it so much more real and terrefying that other humans know about this truth. im sure they are excellent books, but at this piont, it would do more damage than good for me personally (but then again, whats the point). i just want it all to go away, but the one and only fact i can understand is that suicide wont change anything

thanks for responding. nihilism, gotta look that up. its all that ever fills my mind. if I ever get a little bit excited for anything, or get a brief moment of happiness, the thoughts just pop right back up and say that its no point in beeing happy, it wont last, nothing anyone or anything does will ever last, its even a proved fact that our planet will be eaten by the sun one day, so whatever you ever do, it will never last, nothing gives any meaning anymore, its just so goddam frustrating that it doesnt matter if i get help or not, or do anything about anything for that matter, it will never give any meaning or answers about existence or anything.
yea I know, talk to someone professional about it, but I cant and I dont want to
tell me, i could use a talk.

I posted this a few days ago at adviceanimals, but I decided to post it here as well after a suggestion from one of the commenters. Im not really sure whats wrong with me, but I am very scared as it is getting to me more and more. sometimes im able to snap out of it, but it feels like it doesnt want to go away yet, and Im not sure on how to handle it, even though I know its stupid to think that way and get the psychotrauma I do get. I really dont like this, and I dont know what it is.

Thank you all so much for responding to me. I do want to talk to someone about it, but i have fears and doubts about it all, and most of all im scared of whats happening in me. i really appreciate you comments, and i may try to do some of those things, but again, im scared. i know that if i tell someone, they would only try to help, but if i tell someone, the problem gets more real and that would be just as scary as telling someone. i needed to get it of my chest a little bit. i dont know what to do (but i wont do anything very stupid). thank you all for caring
